en.intro: Arjuna asks Krishna what kind of faith rules those who worship with devotion while setting aside the rules of scripture.
en.body: Arjuna says: O Krishna, what is the standing of those who worship with faith while setting aside the rules of scripture? Is it sattvic, rajasic, or tamasic? Arjuna asks what quality rules people who worship with faith while setting aside scriptural rules. Krishna answers that this faith is born of a person's own nature and then describes the three kinds.
